chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would perform the obligatory prayer on his mount on a rainy day.

key_terms.رَاحِلَتِهِ: His riding mount used for travel
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform the obligatory salat (prayer) on his mount during rain?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed the obligatory salat (prayer) on his mount during a rainy day. It indicates a practical Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition) relevant to prayer rulings in circumstances of difficulty during travel.
